snippet.title: PROCEDURE ZERO — Official Trailer | Free Demo Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Prisoners are vanishing. You're next.

You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information, fight when you have to, and take over the prison before they come for you.

▶ FREE DEMO + WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147680/PROCEDURE_ZERO/
▶ STEAM NEXT FEST: October 19–26, 2026
▶ FULL GAME: November 12, 2026

PROCEDURE ZERO is a first-person stealth game made by one developer in Poland. Text in 23 languages, 6 with full voice-over. Built in Unreal Engine 5.
